hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); printf '%s\n' "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env(\.|$)' && ! printf '%s\n' "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env\.(example|sample|template)$' && { echo 'Blocked: .env edits require manual review' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && uv run --no-sync ruff check --fix --unfixable F401 "$f" 2>/dev/null) ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && npx --no-install biome format --write "$f" 2>/dev/null) ;; esac; exit 0
